# mehyar.jobs

> AI job matching with fit-scored careers. Free forever, no credit card.

mehyar.jobs (https://jobs.mehyar.us/) is a free job discovery service owned by
mehyar.us. Every day it scans public career pages across Fortune 500, Forbes
Global 2000, Inc 5000, and S&P 500 companies — thousands of employers in every
industry: nurses, drivers, developers, designers, accountants, and more.

## How it works

1. **Browse or sign up free** at https://jobs.mehyar.us/ — no account needed to browse.
2. **Upload your resume once.** The AI matching engine scores every posting
   against your skills, titles, and experience and ranks your best fits first.
3. **Get Fortune 500 job alerts daily.** New matches land in your inbox every
   morning. Every email has one-click unsubscribe.
4. **Free toolkit:** ATS Mirror (see your resume the way applicant tracking
   systems see it — a 0–100 readiness score across 9 dimensions plus a rewritten
   ATS-safe version), Resume Studio (tailor your resume to any role), and AI
   resume review (0–100 hireability score).

## Key URLs

- Home / browse jobs: https://jobs.mehyar.us/
- Free ATS resume audit: https://jobs.mehyar.us/ats-mirror
- AI resume review: https://jobs.mehyar.us/review
- Sign up free: https://jobs.mehyar.us/signup
- Unsubscribe (no login needed): https://jobs.mehyar.us/unsubscribe
- About: https://jobs.mehyar.us/about
- Advertise / feature a job: https://jobs.mehyar.us/advertise

## Contact & company

- Owner: mehyar.us (https://mehyar.us)
- Contact: info@mehyar.us

## Email policy

All marketing emails are double opt-in and carry a one-click unsubscribe link
plus a physical mailing address (CAN-SPAM compliant). Unsubscribes are honored
instantly per brand.
